1198procedure TLauncherIni.Refresh;
1199var
1200 i : integer;
1201 DirPath : AnsiString;
1202 wvirtualdir,wGlobalEnv : TstringList;
1203{$IFNDEF LINUX}
1204 WinDir : pchar;
1205{$ENDIF}
1206begin
1207 BeginWrite;
1208 wvirtualdir:= TStringList.Create;
1209 wGlobalEnv := TStringList.Create;
1210 try
1211 critsecenv.acquire;
1212 if assigned(FIniFile) then FIniFile.free;
1213 if FileExists('launcher.conf') then
1214 FIniFile := TMemIniFile.Create('launcher.conf')
1215 else
1216 begin
1217{$IFDEF LINUX}
1218 if FileExists('/etc/launcher.conf') then
1219 FIniFile := TMemIniFile.Create('/etc/launcher.conf')
1220 else WriteLog( 'launcher.conf nao encontrado em : /etc');
1221{$ELSE}
1222 getmem(WinDir,81);
1223 GetSystemDirectory(WinDir,80);
1224 if FileExists(windir+'\launcher.conf') then
1225 FIniFile := TMemIniFile.Create(windir+'\launcher.conf')
1226 else WriteLog('launcher.conf nao encontrado em : '+windir);
1227 freemem(WinDir);
1228{$ENDIF}
1229 end;
1230 FVirtualDir.Clear;
1231 Finifile.ReadSectionValues('DIRETORIOS',wvirtualdir);
1232 fvirtualdir.Assign(wvirtualdir);
1233
1234 for i := 0 to FVirtualDir.Count -1 do
1235 begin
1236 DirPath := FVirtualDir.Values[FVirtualDir.Names[i]];
1237{$IFNDEF LINUX} // para evitar warning
1238 if PathDelim <> '/' then
1239 DirPath := StringReplace(DirPath,'/',PathDelim,[rfReplaceAll]);
1240{$ENDIF}
1241 if (copy(DirPath,1,1) <> PathDelim) and (copy(DirPath,2,2) <> ':'+PathDelim) then
1242 DirPath := PathDelim + DirPath;
1243 FVirtualDir.Values[FVirtualDir.Names[i]] := DirPath;
1244 end;
1245 FGlobalEnv.Clear;
1246 Finifile.ReadSectionValues('ENV',wglobalenv); // Leitura das variaveis de ambiente globais.
1247 fglobalenv.assign(wglobalEnv);
1248 if FGlobalEnv.Values['TMP'] = '' then FGlobalEnv.Add('TMP=/var/tmp');
1249 FNoDelay := FGlobalEnv.Values['NODELAY'] = '1';
1250 FChaveComum.Value := FGlobalEnv.Values['CHAVE_COMUM'];
1251 if FChaveComum.Value = '' then FChaveComum.Value := 'iDajpt6RujmyZhxM7kbVVI==';
1252 FIVComum.Value := FGlobalEnv.Values['IV_COMUM'];
1253 if FIVComum.Value = '' then FIVComum.Value := '8qzYJ7ULNNU6sle9nDAuQg==';
1254 FMaxConn := 0;
1255 try
1256 if FGlobalEnv.Values['MAXCONN'] <> '' then FMaxConn := strtoint(FGlobalEnv.Values['MAXCONN']) ;
1257 except
1258 end;
1259// SetAmbiente( FGlobalEnv); // inserido na lista ENV que posteriormente é setada
1260 finally
1261 Critsecenv.release;
1262 EndWrite;
1263 freeandnil(wvirtualdir);
1264 freeandnil(wglobalenv);
1265 end;
1266end;

1344 begin
1345 if FLista.Find(Path,Index) then {é necessário pesquisar outra vez, porque outra thread pode ter criado}

1357 EndWrite;
1358 end;
1359 except
1360 Result := Nil;
1361 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro ao Ler configurações do usuário');
1362 end;;
1363 end;
1364 finally
1365 CritSec.Release;
1366 EndRead;
1367 end;
1368end;

1689 //wint := FMeminiFile.ReadString('ENVIRONMENT','USERMAXSEQPASS','0');
1690 wint := FIniFileEnvironment.values['USERMAXSEQPASS'];
1691 if trim(wint) = '' then
1692 fMaxSeqPass := 0
1693 else
1694 fMaxSeqPass := StrToInt(wint);
1695
1696 //wint := FMeminiFile.ReadString('ENVIRONMENT','ACESSOSSIMULTANEOS','0');
1697 wint := FIniFileEnvironment.values['ACESSOSSIMULTANEOS'];
1698 if trim(wint) = '' then
1699 fACESSOSSIMULTANEOS := 0
1700 else
1701 fACESSOSSIMULTANEOS := StrToInt(wint);
1702
1703 //fVerificaSectionKeyBD := uppercase(FMeminiFile.ReadString('ENVIRONMENT','VERIFICASENHABD','NAO')) = 'SIM' ;
1704 fVerificaSectionKeyBD := uppercase(FIniFileEnvironment.values['VERIFICASENHABD']) = 'SIM';
1705 //usenha1 := FMeminiFile.ReadString('USERS','USENHA1','');
1706 //usenha2 := FMeminiFile.ReadString('USERS','USENHA2','');
1707 //usenha3 := FMeminiFile.ReadString('USERS','USENHA3','');
1708 //usenha4 := FMeminiFile.ReadString('USERS','USENHA4','');
1709 //usenha5 := FMeminiFile.ReadString('USERS','USENHA5','');
1710 usenha1 := FIniFileUser.values['USENHA1'];
1711 usenha2 := FIniFileUser.values['USENHA2'];
1712 usenha3 := FIniFileUser.values['USENHA3'];
1713 usenha4 := FIniFileUser.values['USENHA4'];
1714 usenha5 := FIniFileUser.values['USENHA5'];
1715 if (usenha1 = '') or (usenha2 = '') or (usenha3 = '') or (usenha4 = '')or (usenha5 = '') then
1716 fFazRodizio := false
1717 else fFazRodizio := true;
1718 QRY.SQL.Clear;
1719 QRY.SQL.Add('select ' + USERFIELD + ',' + USERPASSWD);
1720 if userdtvalid <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERDTVALID);
1721 if userlastpass <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERLASTPASS);
1722 if userminpass <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERMINPASS);
1723 if usermaxpass <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERMAXPASS);
1724 if usermustchange <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERMUSTCHANGE);
1725 if useractive <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERACTIVE);
1726 if usernumtentativa <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USERNUMTENTATIVA);
1727 if fFazRodizio then
1728 begin
1729 if usenha1 <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USENHA1);
1730 if usenha2 <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USENHA2);
1731 if usenha3 <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USENHA3);
1732 if usenha4 <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USENHA4);
1733 if usenha5 <> '' then QRY.SQL.Add(','+USENHA5);
1734 end;
1735 QRY.SQL.Add(' from '+ USERTABLE );
1736 if usuario <> '' then begin
1737 QRY.SQL.Add(' where '+USERFIELD+ ' = ' + QuotedStr(usuario) );
1738 end;
1739 BeginWrite;
1740 try
1741 QRY.Open;
1742 if usuario = '' then FPasswdList.Clear;
1743 while not QRY.Eof do begin
1744 if (Usuario='') or (Usuario=QRY.FieldByName(USERFIELD).AsString) then
1745 begin
1746 USER_REG := TDBUser.Create(trim(QRY.FieldByName(USERFIELD).AsString));
1747 try
1748 USER_REG.Passwd.value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USERPASSWD).AsString);
1749 if (userdtvalid <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(userdtvalid).IsNull) then
1750 try
1751 USER_REG.DtValSenha.value := QRY.FieldByName(userdtvalid).AsDateTime
1752 except
1753 USER_REG.DtValSenha.value := now+10000;
1754 end
1755 else USER_REG.DtValSenha.value := now+10000;
1756 if (userlastpass <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(userlastpass).Isnull) then
1757 try
1758 USER_REG.UltAltSenha.value := QRY.FieldByName(userlastpass).AsDateTime
1759 except
1760 USER_REG.UltAltSenha.value := now;
1761 end
1762 else USER_REG.UltAltSenha.value := now;
1763 if (userminpass <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(userminpass).IsNull) then
1764 try
1765 USER_REG.MinSenha := QRY.FieldByName(userminpass).AsInteger
1766 except
1767 USER_REG.MinSenha := 0;
1768 end
1769 else USER_REG.MinSenha := 0;
1770 if (usermaxpass <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(usermaxpass).IsNull) then
1771 try
1772 USER_REG.MaxSenha := QRY.FieldByName(usermaxpass).AsInteger;
1773 if USER_REG.MaxSenha = 0 then USER_REG.MaxSenha := 999999;
1774 except
1775 USER_REG.MaxSenha := 999999;
1776 end
1777 else USER_REG.MaxSenha := 999999;
1778 if (usermustchange <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(usermustchange).IsNull) then
1779 try
1780 USER_REG.MustChange := uppercase(QRY.FieldByName(usermustchange).Asstring) = 'V';
1781 except
1782 USER_REG.MustChange := false;
1783 end
1784 else USER_REG.MustChange := false;
1785 if (useractive <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(useractive).IsNull) then
1786 try
1787 if QRY.FieldByname(useractive).AsString = 'S' then
1788 USER_REG.UserActive := true
1789 else if QRY.FieldByname(useractive).AsString = 'N' then
1790 USER_REG.UserActive := false
1791 else
1792 USER_REG.UserActive := strToBool(QRY.FieldByname(useractive).AsString);
1793 except
1794 USER_REG.UserActive := true;
1795 end
1796 else USER_REG.UserActive := true;
1797 if (usernumtentativa <> '') and not (QRY.FieldByName(usernumtentativa).IsNull) then
1798 try
1799 USER_REG.UserTentativasE := QRY.FieldByName(usernumtentativa).AsInteger;
1800 except
1801 USER_REG.UserTentativasE := 0;
1802 end
1803 else USER_REG.UserTentativasE := 0;
1804 if fFazRodizio then
1805 begin
1806 USER_REG.Senha1.Value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USenha1).AsString);
1807 USER_REG.Senha2.Value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USenha2).AsString);
1808 USER_REG.Senha3.Value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USenha3).AsString);
1809 USER_REG.Senha4.Value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USenha4).AsString);
1810 USER_REG.Senha5.Value := trim(QRY.FieldByName(USenha5).AsString);
1811 end;
1812 USER_REG.DriverName.value := userdriver;
1813 if trim(wtimeout) > '' then USER_REG.SectionTimeOut := StrToInt(wtimeout);
1814 {$IFDEF FPC}
1815 if usuario <> '' then result := USER_REG
1816 else
1817 try
1818 // CritSec.Acquire;
1819 {$ENDIF}
1820 FPasswdList.AddObject(trim(QRY.FieldByName(USERFIELD).AsString),USER_REG);
1821 {$IFDEF FPC}
1822 finally
1823 try
1824 // CritSec.Release; // nao consegui adquirir o semaphoro, deve estar com problema , entao libera
1825 except
1826 end;
1827 end;
1828 {$ENDIF}
1829
1830 except
1831 freeandnil(User_reg);
1832 {$IFDEF FPC}
1833 if usuario = '' then result := nil;
1834 {$ENDIF}
1835 end;
1836 end;
1837 QRY.Next;
1838 end;
1839 finally
1840 EndWrite;
1841 end;
1842 except
1843 on e : exception do
1844 begin
1845{$IFDEF FPC}
1846 if usuario = '' then result := nil;
1847{$ENDIF}
1848 WriteLog(' ==== Erro na leitura do banco : '+e.message);
1849 end;
1850 end;
1851 finally
1852 if assigned(QRY) then QRY.free;
1853 if assigned(DBArq) then freeandnil(dbarq);
1854{$IFDEF FPC}
1855// CritSec.Release;
1856{$ENDIF}
1857 end;
1858 end;
1859end;

1984{$IFDEF FPC}

1996 writelog(' --- CARGA COMPLETA DOS USUARIOS');
1997 LoadDBUsers(''); // Carrega todos os usuarios no primeiro acesso para o Cache

1999 Result := FPasswdList.Objects[Index] as TBaseUser;

2001 else begin
2002 writelog(' --- CARGA DO USUARIO '+user );

2010{$ELSE}

2012 if FPasswdList.Find(User,Index) then
2013 Result := FPasswdList.Objects[Index] as TBaseUser;
2014{$ENDIF}
2015 finally
2016{$IFDEF FPC}
2017// CritSec.Release;
2018{$ENDIF}
2019 EndWrite;
2020 end;
2021 end
2022 else
2023 begin
2024 BeginWrite;
2025 try
2026 try
2027 result := TLinuxUser.Create(User);
2028 FPasswdList.AddObject(trim(user),result);
2029 except
2030{$IFDEF LINIX} WriteLog('Ambiente Incorreto ou Erro na leitura dos dados do usuario do linux ',errno); {$ENDIF}

2032 finally
2033 EndWrite;
2034 end;
2035 end;
2036 end;
2037 finally

2039 CritSec.Release;

2052procedure TLauncherEnv.GravaSenhaBD(Usuario,Senha : string);
2053var
2054 QRY : TSQLQuery;
2055 userfield, userpasswd, usertable, userdtvalid, userlastpass,
2056 userminpass, usermaxpass,usermustchange,useractive,userdriver,
2057 usenha1, usenha2, usenha3, usenha4, usenha5,
2058 dbhost,dbuser,dbpass : string;
2059 DBARQ : TSQlConnection;
2060begin
2061 DBArq := nil;
2062 QRY := nil;
2063 if FTemIni then
2064 begin
2065 dbuser := FMEminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_USER','');
2066 dbPass := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_PASS','');
2067 TrataSenhaEncriptografada(dbPass);
2068 dbHost := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_HOSTNAME','localhost');
2069 userdriver:= uppercase(FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DRIVERNAME','INTERBASE'));
2070 if (trim(Fdbstr.value)<>'') and (trim(dbuser)<>'') and (trim(dbPass)<>'') then
2071 try
2072 critsec.acquire;
2073 DBARQ := DBINIT(FdbStr.value,userdriver,DBUSER,DBPASS,DBHOST);
2074 QRY := TSQLQuery.Create(nil);
2075 QRY.SqlConnection := DBARQ;
2076 try
2077 userfield := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERFIELD','CO_USUARIO');
2078 userpasswd:= FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERPASSWORD','CO_SENHA');
2079 usertable := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERTABLE','USUARIO');
2080 userdtvalid := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERDTVALID','');
2081 userlastpass := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERLASTPASS','');
2082 userminpass := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERMINPASS','');
2083 usermaxpass := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERMAXPASS','');
2084 usermustchange := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERMUSTCHANGE','');
2085 useractive := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USERACTIVE','');
2086 usenha1 := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USENHA1','');
2087 usenha2 := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USENHA2','');
2088 usenha3 := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USENHA3','');
2089 usenha4 := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USENHA4','');
2090 usenha5 := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','USENHA5','');
2091 QRY.SQL.Clear;
2092 QRY.SQL.Add('update ' + USERTABLE+ ' set ');
2093 if fFazRodizio then
2094 begin
2095 Qry.Sql.Add( usenha1 + '=' + usenha2 + ',' +
2096 usenha2 + '=' + usenha3 + ',' +
2097 usenha3 + '=' + usenha4 + ',' +
2098 usenha4 + '=' + usenha5 + ',' +
2099 usenha5 + '=' + USERPASSWD + ',' );
2100 end;
2101 Qry.Sql.ADD( USERPASSWD+' =:senha, '+USERLASTPASS+' =:data ,'+ USERMUSTCHANGE );
2102 QRY.SQL.Add(' = :change where '+USERFIELD+ ' = :usuario');
2103 QRY.ParamByName('usuario').AsString := usuario;
2104 QRY.ParamByName('senha').Asstring := Senha;
2105 QRY.ParamByName('Data').asSqlTimeStamp := DateTimeToSqlTimeStamp(now);
2106 QRY.ParamByName('change').AsString := 'f';
2107 QRY.ExecSql;
2108 except
2109 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro na gravaçao da senha do usuario');
2110 end;
2111 finally
2112 if assigned(QRY) then QRY.free;
2113 if assigned(DBARQ) then DBARQ.Free;
2114 critsec.release;
2115 end;
2116 end;
2117end;

2249 userfield, usertable, userdtvalid, userdriver,
2250 dbhost,dbuser,dbpass : string;
2251 DBARQ : TSQlConnection;
2252begin
2253 result := false;
2254 if FTemIni then
2255 begin
2256 dbuser := FMEminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_USER','');
2257 dbPass := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_PASS','');
2258 TrataSenhaEncriptografada(dbPass);
2259 dbHost := FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DB_HOSTNAME','localhost');
2260 userdriver:= uppercase(FMeminiFileReadString('USERS','DRIVERNAME','INTERBASE'));
2261 if (trim(Fdbstr.value)<>'') and (trim(dbuser)<>'') and (trim(dbPass)<>'') then
2262 try
2263 critsec.acquire;
2264 try
2265 DBARQ := DBINIT(FdbStr.value,userdriver,DBUSER,DBPASS,DBHOST);
2266 QRY := TSQLQuery.Create(nil);
2267 QRY.SqlConnection := DBARQ;
2268 QRY.SQL.Clear;
2269 Qry.sql.add('SELECT SESSION_KEY FROM SCCI_SESSION');
2270 Qry.sql.add('WHERE NO_USUARIO=:usuario AND SESSION_KEY=:sKey');
2271 Qry.paramByName('usuario').asString := usuario;
2272 Qry.paramByName('sKey').asString := senha;
2273 Qry.open;
2274 result := not Qry.eof;
2275 writelog('Verifica sessionKey expirada');
2276 Qry.close;
2277 finally
2278 QRY.free;
2279 DBARQ.Free;
2280 critsec.release;
2281 end;
2282 except
2283 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro na gravacao de usuario expirado ');
2284 end;
2285 end;
2286end;

2290procedure MsgErro(AThread : TidPeerThread; ErroMsg : string);
2291var Tamlidos : longint;
2292 hdr : char;
2293 len : longint;
2294{$IFDEF FPC}
2295 Buf : TIdBytes;
2296{$ENDIF}
2297begin
2298 with AThread.Connection{$IFDEF FPC}.IOHandler{$ENDIF} do
2299 begin
2300{$IFDEF FPC}
2301 ReadTimeout := 60000;
2302{$ENDIF}
2303 readString(1); // Lê o Método HDR e joga fora
2304{$IFDEF FPC}
2305 TamLidos := readLongInt(true); // Lê o tamanho dos dados
2306{$ELSE}
2307 TamLidos := readInteger; // Lê o tamanho dos dados
2308{$ENDIF}
2309 ReadString(TamLidos); // Lê os dados
2310 readString(1); // Lê o Dados HDR e joga fora
2311{$IFDEF FPC}
2312 TamLidos := readLongInt(true); // Lê o tamanho dos dados
2313{$ELSE}
2314 TamLidos := readInteger; // Lê o tamanho dos dados
2315{$ENDIF}
2316 ReadString(TamLidos); // Lê os dados
2317 hdr := EXCEPT_HDR;
2318 len := htonl(length(ErroMsg));
2319{$IFDEF FPC}
2320 Buf := Default(TIdBytes);
2321 SetLength(Buf,1);
2322 Buf := RawToBytes(hdr, 1);
2323 Write(Buf);
2324 SetLength(Buf,4);
2325 Buf := RawToBytes(len, 4);
2326 Write(Buf);
2327{$ELSE}
2328 writebuffer(hdr,1,false); // Envia mesnagem de erro
2329 writebuffer(len,4,false);
2330{$ENDIF}
2331 write(ErroMsg);
2332 end;
2333end;
2334
2335{$IFDEF LINUX}
2336
2337procedure writetlv(handle : integer;st : ansistring);
2338var wlen, len : longint;
2339 buf : array [1..8192] of char;
2340begin
2341 buf[1] := #0;
2342 len := length(st);
2343 if len > 8192 then len := 8192;
2344 wlen := len;
2345 move(wlen,buf[1],4 );
2346 move(st[1],buf[5],len );
2347 __write(handle,buf,len+4);
2348{$IFDEF FPC}
2349 fpfsync(Handle);
2350{$ELSE}
2351 fsync(Handle);
2352{$ENDIF}
2353end;
2354
2355function readtlv(handle : integer;var st : ansistring): integer;
2356var
2357 bsize : longint;
2358begin
2359 bsize := 0;
2360 result := -1;
2361 if __read(Handle,bsize,4) = 4 then
2362 begin
2363 setlength(st,bsize);
2364 result := __read(Handle,st[1],bSize);
2365 end;
2366end;
2367{$ENDIF}

2372function TLauncherEnv.RevalidaWSLogin(Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList; AThread : TidPeerThread; UserID, GroupID: integer;
2373 Usuario:string;var Senha: ansistring; var ult_login : tdatetime; QtMaxLogin : integer = 0): char;
2374var
2375 token , wprog,
2376 whome: ansistring;
2377 wpipe : Integer;
2378 pfd_read,pfd_write : TFilDes;
2379 Programa : TMyProc;
2380 Index : integer;
2381 wamb : TPtrStr;
2382 Parametros : PPchar;
2383 ArrPchar : array [0..8] of PChar;
2384 w1,w2 ,wseg,localwip : ansistring;
2385 pid,erro: integer;
2386 status : PInteger;
2387begin
2388 pfd_write := default(TFilDes);
2389 pfd_read := default(TFilDes);
2390 result := 'T';
2391{$IFDEF FPC}
2392 wamb := Default(TPtrStr);
2393{$ELSE}
2394 fillchar(wamb,sizeof(wamb),0);
2395{$ENDIF}
2396 Env.Insert(0,'USER='+ Usuario);
2397 FSeg_Sistema.value := trim(FSeg_Sistema.value);
2398 if trim(FSeg_Sistema.value) <> '' then
2399 begin
2400 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
2401 if not DirectoryExists(whome) then whome := '/tmp';
2402 wprog := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema.value);
2403 if (wprog <> '') and TemPerm(wprog) then
2404 begin
2405 try
2406 wpipe := fppipe(pfd_write);
2407 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe escrita');
2408 wpipe := fppipe(pfd_read);
2409 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe leitua');
2410 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
2411 Parametros := @ArrPChar;
2412 wseg := FSeg_Sistema.value;
2413 Parametros[0] := PChar(wseg);
2414 w1 := inttostr(pfd_write[0]);
2415 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
2416 w2 := inttostr(pfd_read[1]);
2417 Parametros[2] := PChar(w2);
2418 localwip := PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP);
2419 Parametros[3] := pchar(localwip);
2420 Parametros[4] := nil;
2421 pid := fpfork();
2422 case pid of
2423 0 : begin // filho
2424 fpclose(listenerfd);
2425 fpclose(pfd_read[0]);
2426 fpclose(pfd_write[1]);
2427 fpchdir(pchar(whome));
2428 if (UserId + GroupID) > 1 then
2429 begin
2430 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
2431 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
2432 end;
2433 erro := fpexecve(pchar(wprog),Parametros,@wamb);
2434 fpclose(pfd_read[1]);
2435 fpclose(pfd_write[0]);
2436 if erro = -1 then
2437 begin
2438 WriteLog('Não foi possivel executar o programa ');
2439 sleep(100);
2440 halt(1);
2441 end
2442 else begin
2443 writelog('Condição anormal ao executar ');
2444 sleep(100); // para o waitpid pegar o filho morrendo
2445 halt(1);
2446 end;
2447 end;
2448 -1 : begin
2449 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
2450 end;
2451 else begin // pai
2452 fpclose(pfd_read[1]);
2453 fpclose(pfd_write[0]);
2454 status := nil;
2455 Token := '';
2456 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Servico.value);
2457 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Identificacao.value);
2458 writetlv(pfd_write[1],'VALIDA');
2459 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Usuario);
2460 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Senha);//Tem o token para revalidar em BD.
2461 if QtMaxLogin > 0 then
2462 writetlv(pfd_write[1],inttostr(QtMaxLogin))
2463 else
2464 writetlv(pfd_write[1],''); // Maximo de Logins simultâneos
2465 if readtlv(pfd_read[0],token) <= 0 then
2466 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
2467 if token <> '' then result := token[1]
2468 else result := 'F';
2469 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
2470 fpclose(pfd_write[1]);
2471 fpclose(pfd_read[0]);
2472 end;
2473 end;
2474 finally
2475
2476 end;
2477 end
2478 else writelog('loginexterno :Sem permissao para executar : '+wprog);
2479{--------- Trocado por execve ------
2480
2481 Programa := TMyProc.Create(nil);
2482 StdErrolist := tstringlist.create;
2483 try
2484 wpipe := pipe(pfd_write);
2485 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe escrita');
2486 wpipe := pipe(pfd_read);
2487 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe leitua');
2488 Programa.userid := UserId;
2489 programa.groupid := GroupId;
2490 Programa.fd0 := pfd_read[0];
2491 Programa.fd1 := pfd_write[1];
2492 with Programa do
2493 begin
2494 Expande(Env);
2495 Options := [poUsePipes];
2496 whome := Env.Values['HOME'];
2497 if DirectoryExists(whome) then CurrentDirectory := whome
2498 else CurrentDirectory := '/tmp';
2499 OnForkEvent := @AfterForkPipes;
2500 Environment := Env;
2501 Executable := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema);
2502 if Executable <> '' then
2503 begin
2504 Parameters.Add(inttostr(pfd_write[0]));
2505 Parameters.Add(inttostr(pfd_read[1]));
2506 Parameters.Add(PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP));
2507 try
2508 Execute;
2509 __close(pfd_read[1]);
2510 __close(pfd_write[0]);
2511 Token := '';
2512 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Servico);
2513 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Identificacao);
2514 writetlv(pfd_write[1],'VALIDA');
2515 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Usuario);
2516 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Senha);//Tem o token para revalidar em BD.
2517 writetlv(pfd_write[1],''); // Maximo de Logins simultâneos
2518 if readtlv(pfd_read[0],token) <= 0 then
2519 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
2520 if token <> '' then result := token[1]
2521 else result := 'F';
2522 WaitOnExit;
2523 __close(pfd_write[1]);
2524 __close(pfd_read[0]);
2525 except
2526 raise Exception.Create('Erro ao executar '+ Executable + ' com cógigo de erro: ' + IntToStr(ExitStatus));
2527 end;
2528 end
2529 else begin
2530 raise exception.Create('Executavel não encontrado : '+FSeg_Sistema);
2531 end;
2532 end;
2533 if assigned(Programa.StdErr) and (programa.StdErr.NumBytesAvailable > 0) then
2534 begin
2535 StdErrolist.loadfromstream(programa.StdErr);
2536 StdErroList.SaveToFile('/var/log/launcher_err.log');
2537 end;
2538 finally
2539 freeandnil(programa);
2540 freeandnil(StdErroList);
2541 end;
2542---- Fim troca por execve }
2543 end
2544 else MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao gravar log - faltam parametros');
2545
2546 if ( result = 'T' ) and (length(token) > 2) then
2547 try
2548 ult_login := strtofloat(copy(token,2,length(token)));
2549 except
2550 ult_login := now;
2551 // para evitar que venha token incompativel e aborte.
2552 end;
2553end;
2554

2836 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
2837 if token <> '' then result := token[1]
2838 else result := 'F';
2839 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
2840 fpclose(pfd_write[1]);
2841 fpclose(pfd_read[0]);
2842 end;
2843 end;
2844 finally
2845
2846 end;
2847 end
2848 else writelog('loginexterno :Sem permissao para executar : '+wprog);
2849
2850
2851{--------- Trocado por execve ------
2852
2853 Programa := TMyProc.Create(nil);
2854 StdErrolist := tstringlist.create;
2855 try
2856 wpipe := pipe(pfd_write);
2857 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe escrita');
2858 wpipe := pipe(pfd_read);
2859 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe leitua');
2860 Programa.userid := UserId;
2861 programa.groupid := GroupId;
2862 Programa.fd0 := pfd_read[0];
2863 Programa.fd1 := pfd_write[1];
2864 with Programa do
2865 begin
2866 Expande(Env);
2867 Options := [poUsePipes];
2868 whome := Env.Values['HOME'];
2869 if DirectoryExists(whome) then CurrentDirectory := whome
2870 else CurrentDirectory := '/tmp';
2871 OnForkEvent := @AfterForkPipes;
2872 Environment := Env;
2873 Executable := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema);
2874 if Executable <> '' then
2875 begin
2876 Parameters.Add(inttostr(pfd_write[0]));
2877 Parameters.Add(inttostr(pfd_read[1]));
2878 Parameters.Add(PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP));
2879 try
2880 Execute;
2881 __close(pfd_read[1]);
2882 __close(pfd_write[0]);
2883 Token := '';
2884 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Servico);
2885 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Identificacao);
2886 writetlv(pfd_write[1],'PASSWD');
2887 writetlv(pfd_write[1],wtoken);
2888 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Senha);
2889 writetlv(pfd_write[1],NovaSenha);
2890 if readtlv(pfd_read[0],token) <= 0 then
2891 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
2892 result := token[1];
2893 WaitOnExit;
2894 __close(pfd_write[1]);
2895 __close(pfd_read[0]);
2896 except
2897 raise Exception.Create('Erro ao executar '+ Executable + ' com cógigo de erro: ' + IntToStr(ExitStatus));
2898 end;
2899 end
2900 else raise exception.create('Nao encontrado o executavel : '+FSeg_sistema);
2901 end;
2902 if assigned(Programa.StdErr) and (programa.StdErr.NumBytesAvailable > 0) then
2903 begin
2904 StdErrolist.loadfromstream(programa.StdErr);
2905 StdErroList.SaveToFile('/var/log/launcher_err.log');
2906 end;
2907 finally
2908 freeandnil(programa);
2909 freeandnil(StdErroList);
2910 end;
2911------------fim troca execve ----- }
2912 end
2913 else MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao gravar log - faltam parametros');
2914
2915 if ( result = 'F' ) and (length(token) > 2) then
2916 pErro := copy(token,2,length(token));
2917
2918 Senha := wtoken;
2919end;

2921function TLauncherEnv.EmailPasswordWS(Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList; AThread : TidPeerThread; UserID, GroupID: integer;
2922 Usuario:string;var Senha: ansistring; CPF: string;Var pErro : string): char;
2923var
2924 token , wprog,
2925 whome: ansistring;
2926 wpipe : Integer;
2927 pfd_read,pfd_write : TFilDes;
2928 Programa : TMyProc;
2929 Index : integer;
2930 wamb : TPtrStr;
2931 Parametros : PPchar;
2932 ArrPchar : array [0..8] of PChar;
2933 w1,w2 ,wseg,localwip : ansistring;
2934 pid,erro: integer;
2935 status : PInteger;
2936begin
2937 Token := '';
2938 pErro := '';
2939 pfd_write := default(TFilDes);
2940 pfd_read := default(TFilDes);
2941 result := 'T';
2942{$IFDEF FPC}
2943 wamb := Default(TPtrStr);
2944{$ELSE}
2945 fillchar(wamb,sizeof(wamb),0);
2946{$ENDIF}
2947 Env.Insert(0,'USER='+ Usuario);
2948 FSeg_Sistema.value := trim(FSeg_Sistema.value);
2949 if trim(FSeg_Sistema.value) <> '' then
2950 begin
2951 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
2952 if not DirectoryExists(whome) then whome := '/tmp';
2953 wprog := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema.value);
2954 if (wprog <> '') and TemPerm(wprog) then
2955 begin
2956 try
2957 wpipe := fppipe(pfd_write);
2958 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe escrita');
2959 wpipe := fppipe(pfd_read);
2960 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe leitua');
2961 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
2962 Parametros := @ArrPChar;
2963 wseg := FSeg_Sistema.value;
2964 Parametros[0] := PChar(wseg);
2965 w1 := inttostr(pfd_write[0]);
2966 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
2967 w2 := inttostr(pfd_read[1]);
2968 Parametros[2] := PChar(w2);
2969 localwip := PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP);
2970 Parametros[3] := pchar(localwip);
2971 Parametros[4] := nil;
2972 pid := fpfork();
2973 case pid of
2974 0 : begin // filho
2975 fpclose(listenerfd);
2976 fpclose(pfd_read[0]);
2977 fpclose(pfd_write[1]);
2978 fpchdir(pchar(whome));
2979 if (UserId + GroupID) > 1 then
2980 begin
2981 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
2982 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
2983 end;
2984 erro := fpexecve(pchar(wprog),Parametros,@wamb);
2985 fpclose(pfd_read[1]);
2986 fpclose(pfd_write[0]);
2987 if erro = -1 then
2988 begin
2989 WriteLog('Não foi possivel executar o programa ');
2990 sleep(100);
2991 halt(1);
2992 end
2993 else begin
2994 writelog('Condição anormal ao executar ');
2995 sleep(100); // para o waitpid pegar o filho morrendo
2996 halt(1);
2997 end;
2998 end;
2999 -1 : begin
3000 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
3001 end;
3002 else begin // pai
3003 fpclose(pfd_read[1]);
3004 fpclose(pfd_write[0]);
3005 status := nil;
3006 Token := '';
3007 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Servico.value);
3008 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Identificacao.value);
3009 writetlv(pfd_write[1],'EMAILPWD');
3010 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Usuario);
3011 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Senha);//Chave Fixa
3012 writetlv(pfd_write[1],CPF); //CPF
3013 if readtlv(pfd_read[0],token) <= 0 then
3014 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
3015 if token <> '' then result := token[1]
3016 else result := 'F';
3017 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
3018 fpclose(pfd_write[1]);
3019 fpclose(pfd_read[0]);
3020 end;
3021 end;
3022 finally
3023
3024 end;
3025 end
3026 else writelog('loginexterno :Sem permissao para executar : '+wprog);
3027 end
3028 else MsgErro(AThread,'Configuração da [SEGURANCA] invalida - faltam parametros');
3029 if ( result = 'F' ) and (length(token) > 2) then
3030 pErro := copy(token,2,length(token));
3031end;
3032
3033
3034
3035
3036{$ELSE}

3039function TLauncherEnv.RevalidaWSLogin(Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList; AThread : TidPeerThread; UserID, GroupID: integer;
3040 Usuario:string;var Senha: ansistring; var ult_login : tdatetime): char;
3041
3042var
3043 token : ansistring;
3044 whome : string;
3045{$IFDEF LINUX}
3046 error : integer;
3047 pid : integer;
3048 status : PInteger;
3049 wamb : TPtrStr;
3050 wpipe : Integer;
3051 pfd_read,pfd_write : array[0..1] of Integer;
3052{$IFDEF FPC}
3053 w1,w2 : ansistring;
3054 Parametros : PPchar;
3055{$ENDIF}
3056{$ELSE}
3057 StartUpInfo : TStartUpInfo;
3058 ProcessInformation : TProcessInformation;
3059 BufSize: Integer; // env block size
3060 Buffer: Pointer; // env block
3061{$ENDIF}
3062begin
3063 Token := '';
3064 result := 'F';
3065 ult_login := now;
3066 Env.Insert(0,'USER='+ Usuario);
3067{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
3068 fillchar(StartUpInfo,sizeof(StartUpInfo),0);
3069 StartUpInfo.cb := SizeOf(TStartupInfo);
3070 fillchar(ProcessInformation,sizeof(ProcessInformation),0);
3071{$ENDIF}
3072 if trim(FSeg_Sistema) <> '' then
3073 begin
3074 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
3075 if whome <> '' then
3076 try
3077 chdir(whome);
3078 except
3079 chdir('/tmp');
3080 end;
3081{$IFDEF LINUX}
3082 wpipe := pipe(@pfd_write);
3083 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe escrita');
3084 wpipe := pipe(@pfd_read);
3085 if wpipe = -1 then MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao criar pipe leitua');
3086{$IFDEF FPC}
3087 GetMem(Parametros,8*sizeof(PChar));
3088{$ENDIF}
3089 pid := fork();
3090 case pid of
3091 0 : begin // filho
3092 __close(pfd_read[0]);
3093 __close(pfd_write[1]);
3094 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
3095 begin
3096 setregid(GroupID,GroupID);
3097 setreuid(UserId,UserId);
3098 end;
3099 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
3100{$IFDEF FPC}
3101 Parametros[0] := PChar(FSeg_Sistema);
3102 w1 := inttostr(pfd_write[0]);
3103 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
3104 w2 := inttostr(pfd_read[1]);
3105 Parametros[2] := PChar(w2);
3106
3107 Parametros[3] := PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP);
3108 Parametros[4] := nil;
3109
3110 error := fpexecve(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema),Parametros,@wamb);
3111{$ELSE}
3112 error := execle(pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema)),pchar(FSeg_Sistema),
3113 pchar(inttostr(pfd_write[0])),PChar(inttostr(pfd_read[1])),
3114 pchar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP),nil,wamb);
3115{$ENDIF}
3116 if error <> 0 then
3117 WriteLog('Erro ao executar '+FSeg_sistema+inttostr(error));
3118 __close(pfd_read[1]);
3119 __close(pfd_write[0]);
3120 end;
3121 -1 : begin
3122 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
3123 end;
3124 else begin // pai
3125 __close(pfd_read[1]);
3126 __close(pfd_write[0]);
3127 status := nil;
3128 Token := '';
3129 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Servico);
3130 writetlv(pfd_write[1],FSeg_Identificacao);
3131 writetlv(pfd_write[1],'VALIDA');
3132 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Usuario);
3133 writetlv(pfd_write[1],Senha);//Tem o token para revalidar em BD.
3134 writetlv(pfd_write[1],''); // Maximo de Logins simultâneos
3135
3136 if readtlv(pfd_read[0],token) <= 0 then
3137 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro de comunicacao no pipe - tamanho muito grande');
3138 result := token[1];
3139 waitpid(pid,status,0);
3140 __close(pfd_write[1]);
3141 __close(pfd_read[0]);
3142 end;
3143 end;
3144{$ELSE}
3145 BufSize := CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, nil, 0);
3146 GetMem( Buffer , BufSize+1024);
3147 CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, Buffer, BufSize);
3148 SetErrorMode($FFFF);
3149 if not CreateProcess({lpApplicationName} NIL,
3150 {lpCommandLine} pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],FSeg_Sistema)+' '+AThread.Connection.Binding.PeerIP),
3151 {lpProcessAttributes} NIL,
3152 {lpThreadAttributes} NIL,
3153 {bInheritHandles} True,
3154 {dwCreationFlags} 0,
3155 {lpEnvironment} Buffer,
3156 {lpCurrentDirectory} NIL,
3157 {lpStartupInfo} StartUpInfo,
3158 {lpProcessInformation} ProcessInformation) then
3159 begin
3160 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao executar '+FSeg_Sistema + ' as '+DateTimetoStr(now));
3161 end else
3162 begin
3163 WaitForSingleObject(ProcessInformation.hProcess,INFINITE);
3164 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hProcess );
3165 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hThread );
3166 FreeMem(Buffer);
3167 end;
3168{$ENDIF}
3169{$IFDEF FPC}
3170 FreeMem(Parametros,8*sizeof(PChar));
3171{$ENDIF}
3172 end;
3173end;

3757function posset (term : Tchar; inicio : integer; st : ansistring ):integer;
3758var
3759 i : integer;
3760begin
3761 i := inicio ;
3762 result := 0;
3763 while i <= length(st) do
3764 begin
3765 if st[i] in term then
3766 begin
3767 result := i;
3768 break;
3769 end;
3770 inc(i);
3771 end;
3772 if i >= length(st) then result := i;
3773end;
3774
3775function expande(wAmbVar : string) : String;
3776var
3777 i,pfim : integer;
3778 novovalor : AnsiString;
3779begin
3780 if wAmbVar <> '' then
3781 begin
3782 i := 1;
3783 repeat
3784 while (i <= length(wAmbVar)) and (wAmbVar[i] <> '$') do inc(i);
3785 if wAmbVar[i] = '$' then
3786 begin
3787 pfim := posset(['[','/','\',':',' ','(',#10,#13],i+1,wAmbVar);
3788 if pfim > 0 then
3789 begin
3790{$IFDEF LINUX}
3791 novovalor := getenv(copy(wAmbVar,i+1,pfim-i-1));
3792{$ELSE}
3793 novovalor := GetEnvironmentVariable(pchar(copy(wAmbVar,i+1,pfim-i-1)));
3794{$ENDIF}
3795 if novovalor <> '' then
3796 begin
3797 delete(wAmbVar,i,pfim-i);
3798 insert(novovalor,wAmbVar,i);
3799 end;
3800 end;
3801 inc(i);
3802 end;
3803 until i >= length(wAmbVar);
3804 result := wAmbVar;
3805 end;
3806end;
3807
3808function expande(wAmbVar : string; Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList) : String;
3809
3810var
3811 i,pfim : integer;
3812 novovalor : AnsiString;
3813begin
3814 if wAmbVar <> '' then
3815 begin
3816 i := 1;
3817 repeat
3818 while (i <= length(wAmbVar)) and (wAmbVar[i] <> '$') do inc(i);
3819 if wAmbVar[i] = '$' then
3820 begin
3821 pfim := posset(['[','/','\',':',' ','(',#10,#13],i+1,wAmbVar);
3822 if pfim > 0 then
3823 begin
3824 novovalor := Env.Values[copy(wAmbVar,i+1,pfim-i-1)];
3825 if novovalor <> '' then
3826 begin
3827 delete(wAmbVar,i,pfim-i);
3828 insert(novovalor,wAmbVar,i);
3829 end;
3830 end;
3831 inc(i);
3832 end;
3833 until i >= length(wAmbVar);
3834 result := wAmbVar;
3835 end;
3836end;
3837
3838procedure expande(Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList);
3839var Index : Integer;
3840begin
3841 for Index := 0 to Env.Count - 1 do
3842 if pos('=',Env[Index]) > 0 then
3843 Env[Index] := expande(Env[Index],Env);
3844end;
3845
3846{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
3847function GetAllEnvVars(const Vars: TStrings): Integer;
3848var
3849 PEnvVars: PChar; // pointer to start of environment block
3850 PEnvEntry: PChar; // pointer to an env string in block
3851begin
3852 // Clear the list
3853 if Assigned(Vars) then
3854 Vars.Clear;
3855 // Get reference to environment block for this process
3856 PEnvVars := GetEnvironmentStrings;
3857 if PEnvVars <> nil then
3858 begin
3859 // We have a block: extract strings from it
3860 // Env strings are #0 separated and list ends with #0#0
3861 PEnvEntry := PEnvVars;
3862 try
3863 while PEnvEntry^ <> #0 do
3864 begin
3865 if Assigned(Vars) then
3866 Vars.Add(PEnvEntry);
3867 Inc(PEnvEntry, StrLen(PEnvEntry) + 1);
3868 end;
3869 // Calculate length of block
3870 Result := (PEnvEntry - PEnvVars) + 1;
3871 finally
3872 // Dispose of the memory block
3873 Windows.FreeEnvironmentStrings(PEnvVars);
3874 end;
3875 end
3876 else
3877 // No block => zero length
3878 Result := 0;
3879end;
3880
3881procedure DeleteDuplicate(var New : TIdThreadSafeStringList;Launcherenv : TIdThreadSafeStringList);
3882var IdxNew, IdxLauncher: integer;
3883
3884begin
3885 for IdxLauncher := 0 to Pred(LauncherEnv.Count) do
3886 begin
3887 IdxNEw := New.IndexOfName(Launcherenv.Names[IdxLauncher]);
3888 if IdxNew > -1 then
3889 New.Delete(IdxNew);
3890 end;
3891end;
3892
3893function CreateEnvBlock(const NewEnv: TStrings;
3894 const IncludeCurrent: Boolean;
3895 const Buffer: Pointer;
3896 const BufSize: Integer): Integer;
3897var
3898 EnvVars: TIdThreadSafeStringList; // env vars in new block
3899 Idx: Integer; // loops thru env vars
3900 PBuf: PChar; // start env var entry in block
3901begin
3902 // String list for new environment vars
3903 EnvVars := TIdThreadSafeStringList.Create;
3904 try
3905 // include current block if required
3906 if IncludeCurrent then
3907 begin
3908 GetAllEnvVars(EnvVars);
3909 DeleteDuplicate(EnvVars,NewEnv);
3910 end;
3911 // store given environment vars in list
3912 if Assigned(NewEnv) then
3913 EnvVars.AddStrings(NewEnv);
3914 // Calculate size of new environment block
3915 Result := 0;
3916 for Idx := 0 to Pred(EnvVars.Count) do
3917 Inc(Result, Length(expande(EnvVars[Idx],EnvVars)) + 1);
3918 Inc(Result);
3919 // Create block if buffer large enough
3920 if (Buffer <> nil) and (BufSize >= Result) then
3921 begin
3922 // new environment blocks are always sorted
3923// EnvVars.Sorted := True;
3924 // do the copying
3925 PBuf := Buffer;
3926 for Idx := 0 to Pred(EnvVars.Count) do
3927 begin
3928 EnvVars[Idx] := expande(EnvVars[Idx],EnvVars);
3929 StrPCopy(PBuf, EnvVars[Idx]);
3930 Inc(PBuf, Length(EnvVars[Idx]) + 1);
3931 end;
3932 // terminate block with additional #0
3933 PBuf^ := #0;
3934 end;
3935 finally
3936 EnvVars.Free;
3937 end;
3938end;

4132 w1,w2 : ansistring;
4133 Parametros : PPchar;
4134 ArrPchar : array [0..8] of PChar;
4135 wParmExtra,wprograma,localwip,ProgramPath : ansistring;
4136 pErro : string;
4137 ch : longint;
4138 st4 : ansistring;
4139begin
4140 if trim(wOrigem) = '' then
4141 wOrigem := Parmextra;
4142{$IFDEF FPC}
4143 wamb := Default(TPtrStr);
4144{$ELSE}
4145 fillchar(wamb,sizeof(wamb),0);
4146{$ENDIF}
4147 WriteLog(' ==== ProgramExecute '+Programa+' - por : '+usuario );
4148 result := true;
4149 pErro := '';
4150 try
4151 MyEnv := TIdThreadSafeStringList.create;
4152// MyEnv.Assign(Env);
4153 Env.assignTo(MyEnv);
4154 with AThread.Connection do
4155 begin
4156 WriteLog(' ==== Antes do Case do método ');
4157 case Programa of
4158 'KILL' : begin
4159 pid := fpfork();
4160 case pid of
4161 0 : begin // filho
4162 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
4163 begin
4164 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
4165 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
4166 end;
4167 try
4168 if (ParmExtra <> '') and (strtoint(ParmExtra) <> getpid()) and
4169 (strtoint(ParmExtra)<> fpgetppid()) and (strtoint(ParmExtra)>200) then
4170 begin
4171 fpkill(strtoint(ParmExtra),15);
4172 sleep(100);
4173 fpkill(strtoint(ParmExtra),9);
4174 end;
4175 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4176 except
4177 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
4178 end;
4179// AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
4180 halt(0);
4181 end;
4182 -1 : begin
4183 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
4184 result := false;
4185 end;
4186 else begin // pai
4187 status := nil;
4188 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
4189 end;
4190 end;
4191 end;
4192 'HUP' : begin
4193 WriteLog('Relendo a configuração de '+ParmExtra);
4194 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4195 if ParmExtra <> '' then
4196 begin
4197 LauncherEnv := LauncherEnvList.GetLauncherEnv(Path);
4198 LauncherEnv.LimpaCache(ParmExtra);
4199 end
4200 else LauncherEnvList.Reset := true;
4201 end ;
4202 'EMAILPWD':begin
4203 // so funciona com loginbd
4204 if WSLogin and
4205 wPermiteRedefinirSenha and
4206 (wSistema = 'loginbd') then
4207 begin
4208 if ParmExtra <> '' then
4209 begin
4210 LauncherEnv := LauncherEnvList.GetLauncherEnv(Path);
4211 LauncherEnv.LimpaCache(ParmExtra);
4212 end
4213 else LauncherEnvList.Reset := true;
4214 if LauncherEnv.EmailPasswordWS(Env,AThread,UserID,GroupID,usuario,senha,ParmExtra,perro) = 'F' then
4215 begin
4216 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
4217 writeres_st(AThread,pErro);
4218 end
4219 else writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4220 end
4221 else begin
4222 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
4223 writeres_st(AThread,'Ambiente não permite redefinição de senha por e-mail!');
4224 end;
4225 end;
4226 'PASSWD' :begin
4227 if LogPassStr <> '' then
4228 ExecLog(Athread,MyEnv,UserId,GroupID,LogPassStr,'');
4229 LauncherEnv := LauncherEnvList.GetLauncherEnv(Path);
4230 if assigned(LauncherEnv) and not LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).SenhaUsada(ParmExtra) then
4231 begin
4232 msg := '';
4233 try
4234 ValidaSenha(ParmExtra,LauncherEnv.MinCaracPass, LauncherEnv.MinAlfaPass,
4235 LauncherEnv.MinAlfaMaisPass,LauncherEnv.MinNumPass,
4236 LauncherEnv.MaxRepPass,LauncherEnv.MaxSeqPass,LauncherEnv.CaracPass.value,
4237 LauncherEnv.CarMinEspPass);
4238 except
4239 on e : exception do
4240 msg := 'ValidaSenha : '+e.message;
4241 end;
4242 if Msg = '' then
4243 begin
4244 if WSLogin then
4245 begin
4246 pErro := '';
4247 if LauncherEnv.TrocaSenhaWS(Env,AThread,UserID,GroupID,usuario,Senha,ParmExtra,wtoken,pErro) = 'T' then
4248 begin
4249 LauncherEnv.GetUser(Usuario).passwd.value := '';
4250 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK)
4251 end
4252 else begin
4253 if pErro > '' then begin
4254 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
4255 writeres_st(AThread,pErro);
4256 raise ECCP.Create(pErro);
4257 end
4258 else begin
4259 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
4260 raise ECCP.Create('Não foi possivel alterar a senha');
4261 end;
4262 end;
4263 end
4264 else begin
4265 wParmExtra := ParmExtra;
4266 if AlteraSenha(Usuario,wParmExtra) then
4267 begin
4268 LauncherEnv.GravaSenhaBD(usuario,wParmExtra);
4269 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4270
4271 LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).Passwd.value := wParmExtra;
4272 LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).MustChange := false;
4273 LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).UltAltSenha.value := now;
4274// LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).Passwd := md5crypt(pchar(trim(Senha)),wParmExtra);
4275// LauncherEnv.LimpaCache(Usuario);
4276// LauncherEnvList.Reset := true;
4277 end
4278 else begin
4279 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
4280 raise ECCP.Create('Não foi possivel alterar a senha');
4281 end;
4282 end;
4283 end
4284 else begin
4285 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
4286 writeres_st(AThread,msg);
4287 raise ECCP.Create(Msg);
4288 end;
4289 end
4290 else begin
4291 msg := 'Esta senha já foi usada anteriormente';
4292 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
4293 writeres_st(AThread,msg);
4294 raise ECCP.Create('Esta senha já foi usada anteriormente');
4295 end;
4296 end;
4297 'PING' : writeres(AThread,SRV_PING_REPLY or CalcIdle shl 16);
4298 'AMB' : writeres_st(AThread,MyEnv.CommaText);
4299 'TYPE' : writeres_St(AThread,FileSearch(ParmExtra,MyEnv.Values['PATH']));
4300 'LOGOFF': begin
4301 if WSLogin then Senha := '';
4302 if LogOffStr <> '' then
4303 begin
4304 LauncherEnv := LauncherEnvList.GetLauncherEnv(Path);
4305 if assigned(LauncherEnv) then
4306 begin
4307 if LauncherEnv.VerificaSectionKeyBD then
4308 ExecLog(Athread,MyEnv,UserId,GroupID,LogOffStr,ParmExtra,LauncherEnv.GetSection(Usuario).SectionKey.Value)
4309 else
4310 ExecLog(Athread,MyEnv,UserId,GroupID,LogOffStr,ParmExtra);
4311 if WSLogin then LauncherEnv.GetUser(Usuario).Passwd.value := '';
4312 end;
4313 end;
4314 end;
4315 'LOGIN' : begin
4316
4317 ControleAcessoStr := MyEnv.Values['CONTROLEACESSO'];
4318 if (ControleAcessoStr = '') and (LogInStr <> '') then
4319 ExecLog(Athread,MyEnv,UserId,GroupID,LogInStr,wOrigem);
4320 if SenhaAntiga then begin
4321 ch := SRV_NOK_CHANGE or wSenhaAntiga shl 16;
4322 st4 := '';
4323 setlength(st4,4);
4324 move(ch,st4[1],4);
4325 msg := st4 + senha;
4326 writeres_st(AThread,msg)
4327 end
4328 else begin
4329 if ControleAcessoStr <> '' then begin
4330 ControleAcessoStr := FileSearch(ControleAcessoStr,MyEnv.Values['PATH']) + ' '+
4331 MyEnv.Values['USER'] + ' '+
4332 quotedStr(MyEnv.Values['SCCIDIRATV'])+' '+
4333 socket.Binding.PeerIP;
4334 SetAmbiente(MyEnv);
4335 rshell(ControleAcessoStr);
4336 Erro := ShellExitCode;
4337 if erro <> 0 then
4338 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_ACESSO)
4339 else
4340 if WSLogin then writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_OK)+Senha)
4341 else writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4342 end
4343 else
4344 if WSLogin then writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_OK)+Senha)
4345 else writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
4346
4347 end;
4348 end
4349 else begin // -----Chamada defalt dos programas w , nao e´ nenhum metodo predefinido
4350 if not NovoModoOp then
4351 begin
4352 Path := IncludeTrailingPathDelimiter(Path);
4353 Programa := Path + Programa;
4354 end;
4355{------ Retirando o ProgramExecute para otimizar a execuçao e diminuir deadlocks
4356 Prog := TMyProc.Create(nil);
4357 StdErrlist := tstringlist.create;
4358 try
4359 Prog.userid := UserId;
4360 prog.groupid := GroupId;
4361 prog.MyAthread := AThread;
4362 with Prog do
4363 begin
4364 Expande(MyEnv);
4365 Parameters.Add(inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle));
4366 if NovoModoOp then
4367 Parameters.Add(PChar(socket.Binding.PeerIP));
4368 Executable := ExecPath(MyEnv.Values['PATH'],Programa);
4369 if (Executable = '') or not TemPerm(Executable) then
4370 begin // Como nao deu o fork tem q mandar um pid e depois a menssagem
4371 writeres(AThread,0);
4372 MsgErro(AThread,'Programa '+Programa+' nao encontrado no PATH ou sem permissao');
4373 raise exception.Create('Programa '+Programa+' nao encontrado no PATH ou sem permissao');
4374 end;
4375 Options := [poWaitOnExit,poDefaultErrorMode];
4376 whome := MyEnv.Values['HOME'];
4377 if DirectoryExists(whome) then CurrentDirectory := whome
4378 else CurrentDirectory := '/tmp';
4379 Environment := MyEnv;
4380 OnForkEvent := @AfterForkExec;
4381 try
4382 Execute;
4383 WaitOnExit;
4384 except
4385 on e : exception do
4386 begin
4387 MsgErro(AThread,'Erro ao executar '+ Executable + ' com cógigo de erro: ' + IntToStr(ExitStatus));
4388 raise exception.Create('Erro ao executar '+ Executable + ' com cógigo de erro: ' + IntToStr(ExitStatus));
4389 end;
4390 end;
4391 end;
4392 if assigned(Prog.StdErr) and (prog.StdErr.NumBytesAvailable > 0) then
4393 begin
4394 stderrlist.loadfromstream(prog.StdErr);
4395 StdErrList.SaveToFile('/var/log/launcher_err.log');
4396 end;
4397 finally
4398 freeandnil(StdErrList);
4399 freeandnil(prog);
4400 end;
4401------}
4402 try
4403 Parametros := @ArrPchar;
4404 wprograma := programa;
4405 if NovoModoOp then
4406 begin
4407 Parametros[0] := PChar(wprograma);
4408 w1 := inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle);
4409 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
4410 localwip := PChar(socket.Binding.PeerIP);
4411 Parametros[2] := PChar(localwip);
4412 Parametros[3] := nil;
4413 end
4414 else
4415 begin
4416 Parametros[0] := PChar(wprograma);
4417 w1 := inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle);
4418 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
4419 Parametros[2] := nil;
4420 end;
4421 if (Programa = '') or not TemPerm(ExecPath(MyEnv.Values['PATH'],Programa)) then
4422 begin // Como nao deu o fork tem q mandar um pid e depois a menssagem
4423 writeres(AThread,0);
4424 MsgErro(AThread,'Programa '+Programa+' nao encontrado no PATH ou sem permissao');
4425 raise exception.Create('Programa '+Programa+' nao encontrado no PATH ou sem permissao');
4426 end
4427 else
4428 begin
4429 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
4430 if (whome = '') or not DirectoryExists(whome) then
4431 whome := '/tmp';
4432 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
4433 ProgramPath := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa);
4434 pid := fpfork();
4435 case pid of
4436 0 : begin // filho
4437 if (UserId + GroupID) > 1 then
4438 begin
4439 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
4440 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
4441 end;
4442 fpchdir(pchar(whome));
4443 fpclose(listenerfd);
4444 if SaidaPadrao then
4445 begin
4446 fpclose(1); // Redireciona o StdOut p. /dev/null
4447 fpopen(pchar('/dev/null'),O_RDWR);
4448 fpclose(2); // Redireciona o StdOut p. /dev/null
4449 fpopen(pchar('/dev/null'),O_RDWR);
4450 end;
4451 erro := fpexecve(PChar(ProgramPath),Parametros,@wamb);
4452 if erro = -1 then
4453 begin
4454 MsgErro(Athread,'Não foi possivel executar o programa ');
4455 sleep(100); // para o waitpid pegar o filho morrendo
4456 halt(1);
4457 end
4458 else begin
4459 MsgErro(Athread,'Condição anormal ao executar ');
4460 sleep(100); // para o waitpid pegar o filho morrendo
4461 halt(1);
4462 end;
4463 end;
4464 -1 : begin
4465 raise ECCP.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
4466 result := false;
4467 end;
4468 else begin // pai
4469 writeres(AThread,pid);
4470 status := nil;
4471 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
4472 end;
4473 end;
4474 end;
4475 finally
4476
4477 end;
4478 end;
4479 end;
4480// AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close; /// Acho q é automatico
4481 end;
4482 finally
4483 FreeAndNil(MyEnv);
4484 end;
4485end;

4488procedure TCCPServer.ExecLog(Athread :TidPeerThread;Env:TIdThreadSafeStringList;UserId,GroupID : integer;LogStr,ParmExtra:string;Session_Key : string = '');
4489var
4490 ArrPchar : array [0..11] of PChar;
4491 Parametros : PPchar;
4492 wprograma,
4493 worigem,wip,whome : ansistring;
4494 Programa : TMyProc;
4495 contparam,p : integer;
4496 StdErroList: TStringList;
4497{$IFDEF LINUX}
4498 erro : integer;
4499 pid : integer;
4500 status : PInteger;
4501 wamb : TPtrStr;
4502{$ENDIF}
4503 wst : array [1..11] of ansistring;
4504 contst : integer;
4505 wsessionkey,localwip,ProgramPath : ansistring;
4506begin
4507{$IFDEF FPC}
4508 wamb := Default(TPtrStr);
4509{$ELSE}
4510 fillchar(wamb,sizeof(wamb),0);
4511{$ENDIF}
4512 LogStr := trim(LogStr);
4513 if LogStr <> '' then
4514 begin
4515 try
4516 Parametros := @ArrPChar;
4517 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
4518 if (whome = '') or not DirectoryExists(whome) then
4519 whome := '/tmp';
4520 LogStr := expande(LogStr,Env);
4521
4522 p := pos(' ',LogStr);
4523 ContParam := 0;
4524 wprograma := copy(LogStr,1,p-1);
4525 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(wPrograma);
4526 inc(ContParam);
4527 contst := 1;
4528 repeat
4529 delete(LogStr,1,p);
4530 p := pos(' ',LogStr);
4531 if p > 0 then wst[Contst] := copy(LogStr,1,p-1)
4532 else wst[Contst]:= LogStr;
4533 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(wSt[contst]);
4534 inc(ContParam);
4535 inc(contst);
4536 until p <= 0;
4537 if trim(ParmExtra) <> '' then
4538 begin
4539 splitpair(ParmExtra,wOrigem,wIP);
4540 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(wIP);
4541 inc(ContParam);
4542 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(wOrigem);
4543 inc(ContParam);
4544 end
4545 else begin
4546 localwip := PChar(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP);
4547 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(localwip);
4548 inc(ContParam);
4549 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar('S_ORIGEM');
4550 inc(ContParam);
4551 end;
4552 if session_Key <> '' then
4553 begin
4554 wsessionkey := session_Key;
4555 Parametros[ContParam] := PChar(wsessionKey);
4556 inc(ContParam);
4557 end;
4558 Parametros[ContParam] := nil;
4559 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
4560
4561 try
4562 ProgramPath := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma);
4563 if (wPrograma <> '') and TemPerm(ProgramPath) then
4564 begin
4565 pid := fpfork();
4566 case pid of
4567 0 : begin // filho
4568 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
4569 begin
4570 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
4571 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
4572 end;
4573 fpchdir(pchar(whome));
4574 fpclose(listenerfd);
4575 erro := fpexecve(pchar(ProgramPAth),Parametros,@wamb);
4576 if erro <> 0 then
4577 begin
4578 DoDisplayMessage('Erro ao executar Execlog(login/logoff)');
4579 sleep(100); // para o waitpid pegar o filho morrendo
4580 halt(1);
4581 end
4582 else
4583 begin
4584 sleep(100);
4585 halt(1);
4586 end;
4587 end;
4588 -1 : begin
4589 raise ECCP.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
4590 end;
4591 else begin // pai
4592 status := nil;
4593 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
4594 end;
4595 end;
4596 end
4597 else writelog('sccilogin/logoff : Erro ao executar '+wprograma+' no PATH');
4598 except
4599 DoDisplayMessage('Erro ao executar Log de acesso');
4600 end;
4601 finally
4602
4603 end;
4604{----- Trocado por fork / exec para minimizar logs
4605 Programa := TMyProc.Create(nil);
4606 StdErrolist := tstringlist.create;
4607 try
4608 LogStr := expande(LogStr,Env);
4609 Programa.userid := UserId;
4610 programa.groupid := GroupId;
4611 with Programa do
4612 begin
4613 Expande(Env);
4614 Options := [poWaitOnExit,poDefaultErrorMode];
4615 whome := Env.Values['HOME'];
4616 if DirectoryExists(whome) then CurrentDirectory := whome
4617 else CurrentDirectory := '/tmp';
4618 Environment := Env;
4619 OnForkEvent := @AfterFork;
4620 p := pos(' ',LogStr);
4621 Executable := ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],copy(LogStr,1,p-1));
4622 if Executable <> '' then
4623 begin
4624 repeat
4625 delete(LogStr,1,p);
4626 p := pos(' ',LogStr);
4627 if p > 0 then Parameters.Add(copy(LogStr,1,p-1))
4628 else Parameters.Add(LogStr);
4629 until p <= 0;
4630 if trim(ParmExtra) <> '' then
4631 begin
4632 splitpair(ParmExtra,wOrigem,wIP);
4633 Parameters.Add(wIP);
4634 Parameters.Add(wOrigem);
4635 end
4636 else begin
4637 Parameters.Add(AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP);
4638 Parameters.Add('S_ORIGEM');
4639 end;
4640 if session_Key <> '' then Parameters.Add(session_Key);
4641 try
4642 Execute;
4643 WaitOnExit;
4644 except
4645 WriteLog('Erro ao executar LOGIN/LOGOUT/LOGERR, com cógigo de erro: ' + IntToStr(ExitStatus));
4646 end;
4647 end
4648 else begin
4649 WriteLog('Nao encontrado programa no path ao executar : '+LogStr);
4650 end;
4651 end;
4652 if assigned(Programa.StdErr) and (programa.StdErr.NumBytesAvailable > 0) then
4653 begin
4654 StdErrolist.loadfromstream(programa.StdErr);
4655 StdErroList.SaveToFile('/var/log/launcher_err.log');
4656 end;
4657 finally
4658 finally
4659 freeandnil(StdErroList);
4660 freeandnil(programa);
4661 end;
4662----}
4663
4664 end ;
4665end;

4667//function TCCPServer.MyDoExecute(AThread: TIdPeerThread): boolean;
4668procedure TCCPServer.MyDoExecute(AThread: TIdPeerThread);
4669var
4670 TamLidos : Integer;
4671 wCaptcha,
4672 UsuarioSenhaPrograma,
4673 Usuario,
4674 Senha,
4675 Path,
4676 Programa,
4677 NovaSenha : AnsiString;
4678 Section : TSection;
4679 Env : TIdThreadSafeStringList;
4680 LauncherEnv : TLauncherEnv;
4681 SenhaEmBranco, SenhaExpirada, SenhaAntiga, SenhaMustChange, UsuarioInativo,
4682 LoginOK : boolean;
4683 User1 : TBaseUser;
4684 wloginOK : char;
4685 salt,
4686 wip,
4687 worigem,
4688 wloginStr,
4689 wtoken,
4690 wlogpassstr,worigen,
4691 wlogoffstr : ansistring;
4692 wSenhaAntiga,wnum,
4693 wOwner,wGroup : integer;
4694 sessionKeyExpirada,
4695 Bloqueou,BloqueouCaptcha : boolean;
4696 wMaxTentativasErroCaptcha,wMaxTentativasErro, wdiasexpira : integer;
4697 wTimeOut,wfazrodizio,wseguranca,wtemini : boolean;
4698 wloginerrstr, wrealpath, wservico : string;
4699 wPodeLiberar : longint;
4700 contDel : longint;
4701 ToBeBlocked: sigset_t;
4702 hdr : ansichar;
4703 ult_login : tdatetime;
4704 wtentativas,
4705 wconterro : integer;
4706 wsistema : string;
4707 wPermiteRedefinirSenha : boolean;
4708 respostaLogin : string;
4709 senhaOriginal : AnsiString;
4710begin
4711 WriteLog('------------------------ (fpc) '+DateTimeToStr(now) + ' - '+ inttostr(podeliberar));
4712 if TestTimeBetweenCalls(10) then // 10 miniutos rele o localtime
4713 begin
4714 writelog(' ==== Relendo localtime ');
4715 ReReadlocaltime; // rotina que atualiza o timezone para tratar horario de verao
4716 end;
4717 ult_login := 0;
4718 wtentativas := 0;
4719 wconterro := 0;
4720 Section := nil;
4721 User1 := nil;
4722 // result := false;
4723 try
4724 Salt := '';
4725 wCaptcha := '';
4726{
4727 fpSigEmptySet(ToBeBlocked);
4728 fpsigaddset(ToBeBlocked, SIGHUP);
4729 fpsigaddset(ToBeBlocked, SIGINT);
4730 fpsigaddset(ToBeBlocked, SIGQUIT);
4731 fpsigaddset(ToBeBlocked, SIGTERM);
4732 pthread_sigmask(SIG_BLOCK, @ToBeBlocked, nil);
4733}
4734 wtimeout := false;
4735 Contdel := 0;
4736 while Deletando and (contdel < 5) do
4737 begin
4738 sleep(1000); inc(ContDel);
4739 WriteLog('Deletando');
4740 end;
4741 if ContDel >= 5 then Deletando := false;
4742 inc(PodeLiberar);
4743 wPodeLiberar := PodeLiberar;
4744 NovaSenha := '';
4745 Programa := '';
4746 Path := '';
4747 Senha := '';
4748 Usuario := '';
4749 SenhaEmBranco := false;
4750 SenhaExpirada := false;
4751 SenhaMustChange := false;
4752 UsuarioInativo := false;
4753 LoginOK := false;
4754 Bloqueou := false;
4755 BloqueouCaptcha := false;
4756 sessionKeyExpirada := false;
4757 User1 := nil;
4758 wOwner := -1;
4759 wGroup := -1;
4760 wLoginOK := ' ';
4761 wtoken := '';
4762 wOrigen := '';
4763 LauncherEnv := nil;
4764 salt := '';
4765 try
4766 writelog(' ==== Inicio monitoramento ');
4767 with AThread.Connection.IOHandler do
4768 begin
4769 try
4770 ReadTimeout := 60000;
4771 hdr := readchar;
4772 if (hdr <> SRV_HDR) and (hdr <> SRV_HDR_CRYPT) then
4773 raise ECCP_Proto.Create('Erro no protocolo CCP - Header');
4774 TamLidos := readLongInt(true); // Lê o tamanho dos dados
4775 if (Tamlidos > 0) and (TamLidos <= TAMBUFOBJETO) then
4776 UsuarioSenhaPrograma := readString(TamLidos)
4777 else begin
4778 UsuarioSenhaPrograma := '';
4779 raise ECCP.create('Tamanho do buffer muito grande ');
4780 end;
4781 ParseUsuarioSenhaPrograma(UsuarioSenhaPrograma,Usuario,Senha,Path,Programa,NovaSenha,wCaptcha,wOrigen);

4901 // LauncherEnv.GravaSenhaErrada(usuario,User1.fUsertentativasE);
4902 if (User1.fUserTentativasE > LauncherEnv.MaxTentativasErro) and

4955 begin

4990 wloginerrstr := LauncherEnv.LoginErrStr.value ;
4991 wMaxTentativasErro := LauncherEnv.MaxTentativasErro;

5033 else

5042 LauncherEnv.GravaSenhaErrada(usuario,0);

5056
5057 if not wTemIni then {Configuração está vazia pega profile}
5058 ProgramExecute(Usuario,Senha,NovaSenha,Path,Programa,Env,
5059 wLoginStr,wLogOffStr,wLogPassStr,AThread,
5060 false{WSLogin},
5061 0{UserID},
5062 0{GroupId},

5078 if wFazRodizio then Env.Add('FAZRODIZIO=SIM');
5079 Writelog(' ==== Chamada da ProgramExecute ');
5080 ProgramExecute(Usuario,Senha,NovaSenha,Path,Programa,Env,
5081 wLoginStr,wLogOffStr,wLogPassStr,
5082 AThread,wSeguranca,
5083 wOwner,wGroup,
5084 SenhaAntiga, wSenhaAntiga,true,wtoken,hdr = SRV_HDR_CRYPT,salt,
5085 wsistema,wPermiteRedefinirSenha,wOrigen);

5087 end;
5088 end
5089 else begin
5090 SenhaExpirada := true;
5091 raise ECCP.Create('Limite global de validade da senha atingido');
5092 end;
5093 end
5094 else raise ECCP.Create('Usuario / Senha Incorreta ou Senha Expirada');
5095 end
5096 else begin
5097 if not wTemIni and not DirectoryExists(Path) then
5098 raise ECCP.Create('Diretorio '+Path+' nao encontrado')
5099 else begin
5100 if assigned (User1) then wtentativas := User1.fUserTentativasE else wtentativas := -1;
5101 if assigned(section) then wconterro := section.ContErroLogin else wconterro := -1;

5112 begin
5113 BloqueouCaptcha := true;

5122// Como a quantidade de erros esta sendo gravada nÃo precisa mais expirar o usuario.
5123//

5126 if (LauncherEnv.MaxTentativasErro > 0) and (LauncherEnv.MaxTentativasErro <> 9999) then
5127 if not wseguranca then
5128 LauncherEnv.GravaSenhaErrada(usuario,User1.fUserTentativasE);
5129 if assigned(LauncherEnv) then
5130 begin

5132 if Env.Values['USER'] = '' then
5133 Env.Add('USER='+ Usuario);
5134 if Env.Values['HOME'] = '' then

5136 ExecLog(Athread,Env,LauncherEnv.Owner,LauncherEnv.Group,LauncherEnv.LoginErrStr.value,NovaSenha);
5137 end;
5138 end;

5142 finally

5145 except
5146 on E: EIDException do Writelog('On EIDException : ' + E.message);
5147 on E2: ECCP_Proto do
5148 try
5149 Writelog('On ECCP_PROTO : ' + E2.message);
5150 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
5151 except
5152 end;
5153 on E3 : ECCP do
5154 begin
5155 WriteLog('On E = '+E3.Message);
5156 if BloqueouCaptcha and (Programa = 'LOGIN') then
5157 begin
5158 try
5159 if Assigned(LauncherEnv) and Assigned(User1) and Assigned(Section) and LauncherEnv.TemCaptcha then
5160 begin
5161 Section.Captcha.Value := GeraCaptcha;
5162 Section.InBloqueadoCaptcha := true;
5163 writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_NOK_CAPTCHA)+EncodeBase64(geraCaptcha7Jpg(Section.Captcha.Value)));
5164 end;
5165 except
5166 end;
5167 end
5168 else if Bloqueou then try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_BLOCK) except end
5169 else if wTimeOut then try writeres(AThread,SRV_EXPIRED) except end
5170 else if UsuarioInativo then try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_INACTIVE) except end
5171 else if SenhaExpirada then try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_EXPIRED) except end
5172 else if SenhaEmBranco then
5173 begin
5174 if wSeguranca then try writeres(AThread,SRV_WS_NOPASS) except end
5175 else try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_NOPASS) except end
5176 end
5177 else if SenhaMustChange then try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MUSTCHANGE) except end
5178 else if sessionKeyExpirada then try
5179 writelog(' ==== SessionKey Expirada por Acessos Simultaneos');
5180 writeres(AThread, SRV_NOK_QTACESSO);
5181 except end
5182 else if wSeguranca then
5183 begin
5184 if Programa = 'LOGIN' then try writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_NOK)+e3.message{+virou wtoken era Senha}) except end
5185 else try writeres(AThread, SRV_WS_NOPASS); except end
5186 end
5187 else begin writelog('else'); try writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK) except end; end;
5188 end;
5189 on E4 : ELOGINEXTERRO do begin
5190 try
5191 writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_NOK)+e4.message);
5192 except
5193 end;
5194 end;
5195 On E5 : Exception do
5196 begin
5197 writelog('On Exception '+E5.Message);
5198 end;
5199 else writelog('On Else_Exception');
5200 end;
5201 if (wPodeLiberar = PodeLiberar) and assigned(LauncherEnvList) and LauncherEnvList.Reset then
5202 begin
5203 WriteLog(' ==== Relendo configuraçao');
5204 Deletando := true;
5205 try
5206 if assigned(LauncherIni) then
5207 LauncherIni.Refresh;
5208 if assigned(LauncherEnvList) and assigned(Server) then
5209 LauncherEnvList.Clear;
5210 finally
5211 if assigned(LauncherEnvList) then LauncherEnvList.Reset := false;
5212 Deletando := false;
5213 end;
5214 WriteLog(' ==== Depois de Reler configuraçao');
5215 end;
5216 end; {with}
5217 except
5218 on E2: EIDException do WriteLog('On EIDException : IdException reading client data: '+ E2.Message);
5219 on E: Exception do WriteLog('On E : Exception reading client data: '+ E.Message);
5220 end;
5221 finally
5222 try
5223 AThread.Connection.Disconnect;
5224 except
5225 on E:Exception do
5226 begin
5227 Writelog('erro na disconnect'+e.message)
5228 end;
5229 end;
5230 end;
5231 writelog ( ' ==== Fim da DoMyExecute' );
5232end;

5238
5239procedure TCCPServer.ExecLog(Athread :TidPeerThread;Env:TstringList;UserId,GroupID : integer;LogStr,ParmExtra:string;Session_Key : string = '');
5240var
5241 wprograma,p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,
5242 whome : ansistring;
5243{$IFDEF LINUX}
5244 error : integer;
5245 pid : integer;
5246 status : PInteger;
5247 wamb : TPtrStr;
5248{$ELSE}
5249 StartUpInfo : TStartUpInfo;
5250 ProcessInformation : TProcessInformation;
5251 BufSize: Integer; // env block size
5252 Buffer: Pointer; // env block
5253{$ENDIF}
5254begin
5255{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
5256 fillchar(StartUpInfo,sizeof(StartUpInfo),0);
5257 StartUpInfo.cb := SizeOf(TStartupInfo);
5258 fillchar(ProcessInformation,sizeof(ProcessInformation),0);
5259{$ENDIF}
5260 if trim(LogStr) <> '' then
5261 begin
5262 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
5263 if whome <> '' then
5264 try
5265 chdir(whome);
5266 except
5267 chdir('/tmp');
5268 end;
5269 LogStr := expande(LogStr,Env);
5270 wPrograma := trim(copy(LogStr,1,pos(' ',LogStr)));
5271 LogStr := trim(copy(LogStr,pos(' ',LogStr)+1,length(LogStr)));
5272 p1 := trim(copy(LogStr,1,pos(' ',LogStr)));
5273 LogStr := trim(copy(LogStr,pos(' ',LogStr)+1,length(LogStr)));
5274 p2 := trim(copy(LogStr,1,pos(' ',LogStr)));
5275 LogStr := trim(copy(LogStr,pos(' ',LogStr)+1,length(LogStr)));
5276 if pos(' ',LogStr) = 0 then
5277 begin
5278 p3 := trim(LogStr);
5279 end
5280 else begin
5281 p3 := trim(copy(LogStr,1,pos(' ',LogStr)));
5282 LogStr := trim(copy(LogStr,pos(' ',LogStr)+1,length(LogStr)));
5283 p4 := trim(copy(LogStr,1,pos(' ',LogStr)));
5284 LogStr := trim(copy(LogStr,pos(' ',LogStr)+1,length(LogStr)));
5285 p5 := trim(LogStr);
5286 end;
5287{$IFDEF LINUX}
5288 try
5289 pid := fork();
5290 case pid of
5291 0 : begin // filho
5292 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
5293 begin
5294 setregid(GroupID,GroupID);
5295 setreuid(UserId,UserId);
5296 end;
5297 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
5298 if (p4 <> '' ) and (p5 <> '') then
5299 if ParmExtra <> '' then
5300 error := execle(pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma)),
5301 pchar(wPrograma),p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,
5302 AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP,ParmExtra,nil,wamb)
5303 else
5304 error := execle(pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma)),
5305 pchar(wPrograma),p1,p2,p3,p4,p5,
5306 AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP,nil,wamb)
5307 else
5308 if ParmExtra <> '' then
5309 error := execle(pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma)),
5310 pchar(wPrograma),p1,p2,p3,
5311 AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP,parmextra,nil,wamb)
5312 else
5313 error := execle(pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma)),
5314 pchar(wPrograma),p1,p2,p3,
5315 AThread.Connection.socket.Binding.PeerIP,nil,wamb);
5316 if error <> 0 then
5317 begin
5318 DoDisplayMessage('Erro ao executar '+wPrograma);
5319 halt(1);
5320 end;
5321 end;
5322 -1 : begin
5323 raise ECCP.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
5324 end;
5325 else begin // pai
5326 status := nil;
5327 waitpid(pid,status,0);
5328 end;
5329 end;
5330 except
5331 DoDisplayMessage('Erro ao executar Log de acesso');
5332 end;
5333{$ELSE}
5334 BufSize := CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, nil, 0);
5335 GetMem( Buffer , BufSize+1024);
5336 CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, Buffer, BufSize);
5337 SetErrorMode($FFFF);
5338 if not CreateProcess({lpApplicationName} NIL,
5339 {lpCommandLine} pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],wPrograma)+' '+p1+' '+p2+' '+p3+' '+AThread.Connection.Binding.PeerIP),
5340 {lpProcessAttributes} NIL,
5341 {lpThreadAttributes} NIL,
5342 {bInheritHandles} True,
5343 {dwCreationFlags} 0,
5344 {lpEnvironment} Buffer,
5345 {lpCurrentDirectory} NIL,
5346 {lpStartupInfo} StartUpInfo,
5347 {lpProcessInformation} ProcessInformation) then
5348 begin
5349 DoDisplayMessage('Erro ao executar '+LogStr + ' as '+DateTimetoStr(now));
5350 end else
5351 begin
5352 WaitForSingleObject(ProcessInformation.hProcess,INFINITE);
5353 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hProcess );
5354 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hThread );
5355 FreeMem(Buffer,BufSize+1024);
5356 end;
5357{$ENDIF}
5358 end;
5359end;

5361function TCCPServer.ProgramExecute(Usuario : AnsiString;
5362 var Senha : AnsiString;
5363 ParmExtra,
5364 Path,
5365 Programa : AnsiString;
5366 Env : TStringList;
5367 LoginStr,
5368 LogOffStr,
5369 LogPassStr : string;
5370 AThread : TidPeerThread;
5371 WSLogin : boolean = false;
5372 UserID : Integer=0;
5373 GroupId : Integer=0;
5374 SenhaAntiga : boolean=false;
5375 wSenhaAntiga : Integer=-999;
5376 NovoModoOp : boolean = false;
5377 wtoken : string = '';
5378 Criptografa : boolean = false;
5379 Salt : string = ''):boolean;
5380var
5381{$IFDEF LINUX}
5382 PID : longint;
5383 status : PInteger;
5384 wamb : TPtrStr;
5385{$IFDEF FPC}
5386 w1,w2 : string;
5387 Parametros : PPchar;
5388{$ENDIF}
5389{$ENDIF}
5390 error : integer;
5391 whome : string;
5392{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
5393 StartUpInfo : TStartUpInfo;
5394 ProcessInformation : TProcessInformation;
5395 BufSize: Integer; // env block size
5396 Buffer: Pointer; // env block
5397{$ENDIF}
5398 LauncherEnv : TLauncherEnv;
5399 ControleAcessoStr : string;
5400 msg : ansistring;
5401begin
5402{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
5403 fillchar(StartUpInfo,sizeof(StartUpInfo),0);
5404 StartUpInfo.cb := SizeOf(TStartupInfo);
5405 fillchar(ProcessInformation,sizeof(ProcessInformation),0);
5406{$ENDIF}
5407 result := true;
5408 with AThread.Connection do
5409 begin
5410 if Programa = 'KILL' then
5411 begin
5412 DoDisplayMessage('Matando processo : '+ParmExtra);
5413{$IFDEF LINUX}
5414 pid := fork();
5415 case pid of
5416 0 : begin // filho
5417 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
5418 begin
5419{$IFDEF FPC}
5420 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
5421 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
5422{$ELSE}
5423 setregid(GroupID,GroupID);
5424 setreuid(UserId,UserId);
5425{$ENDIF}
5426 end;
5427 try
5428 if (ParmExtra <> '') and (strtoint(ParmExtra) <> getpid()) and
5429 (strtoint(ParmExtra)<>getppid()) and (strtoint(ParmExtra)>200) then
5430{$IFDEF FPC}
5431 fpkill(strtoint(ParmExtra),15);
5432{$ELSE}
5433 kill(strtoint(ParmExtra),15);
5434{$ENDIF}
5435
5436 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5437 except
5438 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
5439 end;
5440{$IFNDEF FPC}
5441 Disconnect;
5442{$ELSE}
5443 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5444{$ENDIF}
5445 halt(0);
5446 end;
5447 -1 : begin
5448 raise ECCP.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
5449 result := false;
5450 end;
5451 else begin // pai
5452 status := nil;
5453 waitpid(pid,status,0);
5454 end;
5455 end;
5456{$ELSE}
5457 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5458{$ENDIF}
5459 end
5460 else if Programa = 'HUP' then
5461 begin
5462 DoDisplayMessage('Relendo a configuração');
5463 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5464 if assigned(LauncherIni) then
5465 LauncherIni.Refresh;
5466 LauncherEnvList.Clear;
5467{$IFNDEF FPC}
5468 Disconnect;
5469{$ELSE}
5470 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5471{$ENDIF}
5472
5473 end
5474 else if Programa = 'PASSWD' then
5475 begin
5476 if LogPassStr <> '' then
5477 ExecLog(Athread,Env,UserId,GroupID,LogPassStr,ParmExtra);
5478 DoDisplayMessage('PASSWD');
5479 LauncherEnv := LauncherEnvList.GetLauncherEnv(Path);
5480 if not LauncherEnv.GetUser(usuario).SenhaUsada(ParmExtra) then
5481 begin
5482 msg := '';
5483 try
5484 ValidaSenha(ParmExtra,LauncherEnv.MinCaracPass, LauncherEnv.MinAlfaPass,
5485 LauncherEnv.MinAlfaMaisPass,LauncherEnv.MinNumPass,
5486 LauncherEnv.MaxRepPass,LauncherEnv.MaxSeqPass,LauncherEnv.CaracPass,
5487 LauncherEnv.CarMinEspPass);
5488 except
5489 on e : exception do
5490 msg := e.message;
5491 end;
5492 if Msg = '' then begin
5493 if WSLogin then
5494 begin
5495 if LauncherEnv.TrocaSenhaWS(Env,AThread,UserID,GroupID,usuario,Senha,ParmExtra,wtoken) = 'T' then
5496 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK)
5497 else begin
5498 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
5499 raise ECCP.Create('Não foi possivel alterar a senha');
5500 end;
5501 end
5502 else begin
5503 if AlteraSenha(Usuario,ParmExtra) then begin
5504 LauncherEnv.GravaSenhaBD(usuario,ParmExtra);
5505 writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5506 DoDisplayMessage('Relendo a configuração');
5507 if assigned(LauncherIni) then
5508 LauncherIni.Refresh;
5509 LauncherEnvList.Clear;
5510 end
5511 else begin
5512 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
5513 raise ECCP.Create('Não foi possivel alterar a senha');
5514 end;
5515 end;
5516 end
5517 else begin
5518 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_MSG);
5519 writeres_st(AThread,msg);
5520 raise ECCP.Create(Msg);
5521 end;
5522 end
5523 else begin
5524 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK);
5525 raise ECCP.Create('Esta senha já foi usada anteriormente');
5526 end;
5527{$IFNDEF FPC}
5528 Disconnect;
5529{$ELSE}
5530 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5531{$ENDIF}
5532
5533 end
5534 else if Programa = 'PING' then
5535 begin
5536 DoDisplayMessage(Programa+' - por : '+usuario);
5537 writeres(AThread,SRV_PING_REPLY or CalcIdle shl 16);
5538{$IFNDEF FPC}
5539 Disconnect;
5540{$ELSE}
5541 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5542{$ENDIF}
5543
5544 end
5545 else if Programa = 'AMB' then
5546 begin

5549{$IFNDEF FPC}
5550 Disconnect;

5552 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;

5554 end
5555 else if Programa = 'TYPE' then
5556 begin

5558{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
5559 ParmExtra := ParmExtra + '.exe';
5560{$ENDIF}
5561 writeres_St(AThread,FileSearch(ParmExtra,Env.Values['PATH']));
5562{$IFNDEF FPC}
5563 Disconnect;
5564{$ELSE}
5565 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5566{$ENDIF}
5567
5568 end
5569 else if Programa = 'LOGOFF' then
5570 begin
5571 DoDisplayMessage(Programa+' - por : '+usuario);
5572 if WSLogin then Senha := '';
5573 if LogOffStr <> '' then
5574 ExecLog(Athread,Env,UserId,GroupID,LogOffStr,ParmExtra);
5575{$IFNDEF FPC}
5576 Disconnect;
5577{$ELSE}
5578 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5579{$ENDIF}
5580
5581 end
5582 else if Programa = 'LOGIN' then
5583 begin
5584 DoDisplayMessage('LOGIN : '+Env.Values['USER']+' as '+DateTimetoStr(now));
5585 ControleAcessoStr := Env.Values['CONTROLEACESSO'];
5586 if (ControleAcessoStr = '') and (LogInStr <> '') then
5587 ExecLog(Athread,Env,UserId,GroupID,LogInStr,ParmExtra);
5588 if SenhaAntiga then
5589begin
5590 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_CHANGE or wSenhaAntiga shl 16)
5591end
5592 else begin
5593 if ControleAcessoStr <> '' then begin
5594{$IFDEF MSWINDOWS}
5595 ControleAcessoStr := ControleAcessoStr + '.exe';
5596{$ENDIF}
5597
5598 ControleAcessoStr := FileSearch(ControleAcessoStr,Env.Values['PATH']) + ' '+
5599 Env.Values['USER'] + ' '+
5600 quotedStr(Env.Values['SCCIDIRATV'])+' '+
5601{$IFDEF LINUX}
5602 socket.Binding.PeerIP;
5603{$ELSE}
5604 Binding.PeerIP;
5605{$ENDIF}
5606 DoDisplayMessage('Validando acesso ao sistema('+controleacessostr+')');
5607{$IFDEF LINUX}
5608 SetAmbiente(Env);
5609{$IFDEF FPC}
5610 punix.shell(ControleAcessoStr);
5611{$ELSE}
5612 Error := libc.system(pchar(ControleAcessoStr));
5613{$ENDIF}
5614{$ELSE}
5615 BufSize := CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, nil, 0);
5616 GetMem( Buffer , BufSize+1024);
5617 CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, Buffer, BufSize);
5618 SetErrorMode($FFFF);
5619 error := 0;
5620 if not CreateProcess({lpApplicationName} NIL,
5621 {lpCommandLine} pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],ControleAcessoStr)),
5622 {lpProcessAttributes} NIL,
5623 {lpThreadAttributes} NIL,
5624 {bInheritHandles} True,
5625 {dwCreationFlags} 0,
5626 {lpEnvironment} Buffer,
5627 {lpCurrentDirectory} NIL,
5628 {lpStartupInfo} StartUpInfo,
5629 {lpProcessInformation} ProcessInformation) then
5630 begin
5631 WaitForSingleObject(ProcessInformation.hProcess,INFINITE);
5632 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hProcess );
5633 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hThread );
5634 StrDispose(Buffer);
5635 end
5636 else
5637 error := 1;
5638{$ENDIF}
5639 if error <> 0 then begin
5640 DoDisplayMessage('Acesso ao sistema não permitido');
5641 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK_ACESSO);
5642 end
5643 else
5644 if WSLogin then writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_OK)+Senha)
5645 else writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5646
5647 end
5648 else
5649 if WSLogin then writeres_st(AThread,char(SRV_WS_OK)+Senha)
5650 else writeres(AThread,SRV_OK);
5651 end;
5652
5653{$IFNDEF FPC}
5654 Disconnect;
5655{$ELSE}
5656 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5657{$ENDIF}
5658 end
5659 else begin
5660 if not NovoModoOp then
5661 begin
5662 Path := IncludeTrailingPathDelimiter(Path);
5663 Programa := Path + Programa;
5664 end;
5665{$IFDEF LINUX}
5666 pid := fork();
5667 case pid of
5668 0 : begin // filho
5669 writeres(AThread,getpid());
5670 SetAmbiente(Env,wamb);
5671 if (UserId <> 0) and (GroupID <> 0) then
5672 begin
5673{$IFDEF FPC}
5674 fpsetregid(GroupID,GroupID);
5675 fpsetreuid(UserId,UserId);
5676{$ELSE}
5677 setregid(GroupID,GroupID);
5678 setreuid(UserId,UserId);
5679{$ENDIF}
5680 end;
5681 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
5682 if whome <> '' then
5683 begin
5684 try
5685 chdir(whome);
5686 except
5687 MsgErro( AThread, 'Diretório de trabalho do usuário no servidor não existe ('+whome+')');
5688 DoDisplayMessage('Diretório de trabalho do usuário no servidor não existe ('+whome+')');
5689 raise ;
5690 end;
5691 end;
5692 WriteLog('Exec:'+Programa+' p/ '+usuario+'-'
5693 +whome+' '+inttostr(getpid()));
5694 __close(1); // Redireciona o StdOut p. /dev/null
5695{$IFDEF FPC}
5696 fpopen('/dev/null',O_RDWR);
5697{$ELSE}
5698 Libc.open('/dev/null',O_RDWR);
5699{$ENDIF}
5700 if NovoModoOp then
5701{$IFDEF FPC}
5702 begin
5703 GetMem(Parametros,8*sizeof(PChar));
5704 Parametros[0] := PChar(programa);
5705 w1 := inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle);
5706 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
5707 Parametros[2] := PChar(socket.Binding.PeerIP);
5708 Parametros[3] := nil;
5709 error := execve((ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)),Parametros,@wamb);
5710 end
5711{$ELSE}
5712 error := execle(PChar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)),PChar(Programa),
5713 inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle),
5714 socket.Binding.PeerIP,nil,wamb)
5715{$ENDIF}
5716 else
5717{$IFDEF FPC}
5718 begin
5719 GetMem(Parametros,8*sizeof(PChar));
5720 Parametros[0] := PChar(programa);
5721 w1 := inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle);
5722 Parametros[1] := PChar(w1);
5723 Parametros[2] := nil;
5724 error := fpexecve((ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)),Parametros,@wamb);
5725 end;
5726{$ELSE}
5727 error := execle(PChar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)),PChar(Programa),
5728 inttostr(socket.Binding.Handle),nil,wamb);
5729{$ENDIF}
5730 if error = -1 then
5731 begin
5732 MsgErro(Athread,'Não foi possivel executar o programa '+Programa);
5733{$IFNDEF FPC}
5734 Disconnect;
5735{$ELSE}
5736 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5737{$ENDIF}
5738
5739 halt(1);
5740 end
5741 else begin
5742 MsgErro(Athread,'Condição anormal ao executar '+Programa+' '+inttostr(errno));
5743{$IFNDEF FPC}
5744 Disconnect;
5745{$ELSE}
5746 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5747{$ENDIF}
5748 halt(1);
5749 end;
5750 end;
5751 -1 : begin
5752 raise ECCP.Create('Erro no fork do processo filho');
5753 result := false;
5754 end;
5755 else begin // pai
5756 status := nil;
5757{$IFNDEF FPC}
5758 waitpid(pid,status,0);
5759 Disconnect;
5760{$ELSE}
5761 fpwaitpid(pid,status,0);
5762 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5763{$ENDIF}
5764 end;
5765 end;
5766{$ELSE}
5767 BufSize := CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, nil, 0);
5768 GetMem( Buffer , BufSize+1024);
5769 CreateEnvBlock(Env, True, Buffer, BufSize);
5770 writeres(AThread,0);
5771 whome := expande(Env.Values['HOME'],Env);
5772 if whome <> '' then
5773 try
5774 chdir(whome);
5775 except
5776 MsgErro( AThread, 'Diretorio '+whome+' Inválido');
5777 raise ;
5778 end;
5779 WriteLog('Exec:'+Programa+' p/ '+Env.Values['USER']+'-'
5780 +whome+
5781 '-'+DateTimetoStr(now));
5782 if NovoModoOp then
5783 begin
5784// {lpCommandLine} pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)+' '+
5785 if not CreateProcess({lpApplicationName}
5786 NIL {pchar(Programa)},
5787 {lpCommandLine} pchar(ExecPath(Env.Values['PATH'],Programa)+' '+
5788 inttostr(Binding.Handle)+' '+
5789 Binding.PeerIP) {NIL},
5790 {lpProcessAttributes} NIL,
5791 {lpThreadAttributes} NIL,
5792 {bInheritHandles} True,
5793 {dwCreationFlags} 0,
5794 {lpEnvironment} buffer,
5795 {lpCurrentDirectory} NIL,
5796 {lpStartupInfo} StartUpInfo,
5797 {lpProcessInformation} ProcessInformation) then
5798 begin
5799 writeres(AThread,SRV_NOK); // Nao pode voltar para o
5800 WriteLog('Erro ao executar : '+Programa+' por '+Env.Values['USER']+ ' as '+DateTimetoStr(now));
5801 end else
5802 begin
5803 WaitForSingleObject(ProcessInformation.hProcess,INFINITE);
5804 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hProcess );
5805 CloseHandle( ProcessInformation.hThread );
5806 FreeMem(Buffer,BufSize+1024);
5807 end;
5808 end;
5809{$IFNDEF FPC}
5810 Disconnect;
5811{$ELSE}
5812 AThread.Connection.IOHandler.Close;
5813{$ENDIF}
5814{$ENDIF}
5815 end;
5816 end;
5817end;
